text:
paul-sales: Heads-up — AuroRex exec demo blocked by their CISO. They want a short-lived peering + a 20min high-throughput spike for an onsite demo tomorrow 09:30 UTC. Also asking for a firm demo cap and a signed LOA (letter of authorization). Can ops/security advise if we can do this under our standard emergency playbook? :warning:

ana-eng: We can do short peering + transient throughput, but need clarity on two things: 1) are they requesting any IP ranges that are dynamic? 2) do they need any special model tuning during the spike (quantization change or larger batch)?

paul-sales: Customer provided a static /29: 198.51.102.0/29. They want 100Mbps for 20 minutes. No model tuning requested in writing but exec said they might ask for lower-latency config (we should be ready). They will sign LOA if we provide runbook and cost cap.

diego-ops: We can create a TTL peering (3h) and an egress override for a short burst. Draft ACL below — putting minimal surface area: 

```
peering_id: aurorex-exec-demo-01
from_tenant: redwood-sales-demo
to_cidr: 198.51.102.0/29
allowed_ports: [443]
duration_hours: 3
egress_limit_mbps: 100
acl: ["198.51.102.2/32","198.51.102.3/32"]
logging_kms_alias: "alias/aurorex-demo-logs"
tear_down_after: 30m_after_window
```

sofi-security: CISO checklist: TLS-only, dedicated KMS alias, retention policy, SSO read-only for their security reviewer, and an LOA that includes audit access terms. I can fast-track signoff if ops attaches runbook and LOA draft. Also ask legal: do we need an amendment to the demo terms?

runbook-bot: [runbook] RB-33021 created for aurorex-exec-demo-01. Staged config waiting validation.

ana-eng: Two engineering asks: 1) enable KV cache pre-warm 15min before demo; 2) set model-fallback to hosted endpoint with auto-swap if peering fails. Diego, can you add health-checks and a weighted routing policy?

diego-ops: Yep. Adding a pre-warm cron and a health-check every 5s. Weighted routing: primary=peered (weight 100), fallback=hosted-1 (weight 0) with instant failover. Pushed staged config to ticket.

ledger-billing: [billing] provisional demo cap entry: $1,500 for tenant redwood-sales-demo. Needs internal approval to set billing cap.

marie-csm: I can approve the $1,500 capped demo. Paul, please confirm customer PO note acceptance and whether they expect an invoice after demo. I will send LOA template to their procurement.

paul-sales: Customer accepts $1,500 cap and wants invoice after demo. They will sign LOA if runbook + KMS alias are in the ticket. Sending procurement contact.

sofi-security: Reviewing staged runbook and ACL. Condition: logs must be pushed to customer KMS alias and retention set to 45 days. Also require SSO read-only for their reviewer. If LOA template is attached I will sign off.

diego-ops: Runbook and LOA draft uploaded to ticket (RB-33021). Deploying staged peering in eu-west-1 now.

runbook-bot: [deploy] aurorex-exec-demo-01 staged in eu-west-1 — status: staged -> pending validation.

nana-eng: Quick smoke from restricted host: TLS ok, KV warmup running, latency 105ms under warm cache. Model fallback configured.

sofi-security: Signing off. Conditions met: LOA present, KMS alias set to alias/aurorex-demo-logs, retention 45d, SSO access granted to reviewer. :white_check_mark:

ledger-billing: Billing cap set to $1,500. Invoicing terms noted.

marie-csm: LOA sent to procurement and cc'd legal. Procurement acknowledged and will sign on receipt of final runbook confirmation.

paul-sales: Great — scheduling demo and notifying AuroRex execs. Diego please teardown 30 minutes after window.

diego-ops: Teardown scheduled at 11:00 UTC (30m after demo). Will confirm once reverted.

runbook-bot: [reminder] teardown job for aurorex-exec-demo-01 scheduled at 11:00 UTC.

diego-ops: Teardown complete. Peering removed, egress overrides reverted, logs archived to alias/aurorex-demo-logs. Closing runbook RB-33021.

paul-sales: Thanks team — closing this thread and updating the POC ticket. :rocket:
